# Every source, and how often we look at it again

*Generated by `scripts/source_cadence.py` from `sources/data/source-cadence.csv`. Do not edit; edit the register. For each source’s last look, next due date and anything the checks have found, run `python3 scripts/source_cadence.py`.*

**38 sources. 35 are re-checked by the daily refresh; 0 are run by hand; 3 arrive only when we ask.** The refresh runs every morning and looks at each source whose cadence has come round, or passed, since it was last looked at successfully.

## What each source is, and how it is run

| id | command | covers | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meetings` | `watch_meetings.py then fetch_agendas.py --backfill` | sources/meetings/ | refresh.py steps 1-3. Every board's listing is read each morning; a document is fetched the day it is posted. |
| `documents` | `watch_documents.py (fetch_school_budget_docs.py and fetch_town_docs.py --scope no-annual-reports)` | sources/district-budget/, sources/town-budget/, sources/town-supplementary/ | refresh.py step 3d. Finds NEW documents on the listing pages. The annual town reports are left out: see annual-reports. A document replaced in place under its old link is what the copies-* checks below are for. |
| `annual-reports` | `watch_documents.py --annual-reports` | sources/town-annual-reports/ | Finds a NEW annual town report on the town's Annual Town Reports page, DocumentCenter and ArchiveCenter. Quarterly, not daily: the town publishes one a year (TJ, 28 October 2026). A report replaced in place is what copies-town is for. |
| `job-postings-district` | `fetch_school_job_postings.py --if-changed` | sources/district-budget/docs/personnel/ | refresh.py step 3f. Daily because a posting can come down the day it is filled. |
| `job-postings-town` | `fetch_town_job_postings.py --if-changed` | sources/town-supplementary/docs/job-postings/ | refresh.py step 3f. |
| `feeds` | `watch_feeds.py` | linked and attributed; not archived | refresh.py step 3c. |
| `youtube` | `watch_youtube.py then fetch_youtube_transcripts.py` | sources/data/youtube-transcripts/ | refresh.py steps 4-6. |
| `staff-directory-town` | `fetch_staff_directory.py --if-changed` | sources/town-supplementary/docs/staff-directory/ | refresh.py step 3e. The town overwrites the page in place; our snapshots are its only history. |
| `staff-directory-district` | `fetch_school_staff_directory.py --if-changed` | sources/district-budget/docs/personnel/staff-directory/ | refresh.py step 3e. Overwritten in place by the district. |
| `oml-determinations` | `fetch_oml_determinations.py --all --year <this year>` | sources/state-law/ | refresh.py step 3g. In January last year too, for a letter numbered in the old year. |
| `dese-grants` | `fetch_dese_grants.py --if-changed` | sources/state-dese/grants/ | refresh.py step 3h. DESE publishes only the current list and overwrites it. |
| `dese-awards` | `fetch_dese_awards.py` | sources/state-dese/awards/ | refresh.py step 3h. DESE keeps only two years of lists up. |
| `dese-entitlements` | `fetch_dese_entitlements.py --if-changed` | sources/state-dese/entitlements/ | refresh.py step 3i. Revised in place; each page prints its Last Updated. |
| `socrata-dese` | `check_socrata_sources.py` | the socrata rows of sources/data/dese-source-registry.csv | Asks the portal when each dataset's rows last changed against when we took our copy; writes sources/data/socrata-status.csv. Reports only. |
| `socrata-dese-fetch` | `fetch_dese_socrata.py --promote` | the socrata rows of sources/data/dese-source-registry.csv | Downloads only a dataset the portal says has changed, keeps it as a dated version -- so every version DESE has published since we started is held, for comparing over time -- and makes the newest the copy the pages read. What reads it is then re-run: the vetted extractors and builders in source_cadence.UNATTENDED, named in the run notes otherwise. |
| `copies-district` | `verify_source_copies.py --prefix district-budget/ --due-days 30 --max 40` | sources/district-budget/ | A slice a day, oldest check first. Most of these are Google Drive links, which can be replaced without the link changing. Written to sources/data/copy-status.csv. |
| `copies-town` | `verify_source_copies.py --prefix town-budget/ --prefix town-supplementary/ --prefix town-annual-reports/ --due-days 30 --max 20` | sources/town-budget/, sources/town-supplementary/, sources/town-annual-reports/ | A slice a day, oldest check first. |
| `copies-state-dese` | `verify_source_copies.py --prefix state-dese/ --due-days 30 --max 10` | sources/state-dese/ | A slice a day. Covers the RADAR workbook, the Chapter 70 profiles and the selected-populations pages, which DESE overwrites in place. Its snapshot folders and the Socrata exports are left to the jobs above. |
| `copies-state-law` | `verify_source_copies.py --prefix state-law/ --due-days 90 --max 40` | sources/state-law/ | A slice a day. Law changes slowly; ninety days. |
| `copies-other` | `verify_source_copies.py --prefix contracts/ --prefix peer-districts/ --prefix state-census/ --prefix budget-workbooks/ --due-days 90 --max 10` | sources/contracts/, sources/peer-districts/, sources/state-census/, sources/budget-workbooks/ (the two with an address) | A slice a day. |
| `board-pages` | `fetch_board_pages.py` | sources/town-supplementary/ | Compared on what the page SAYS -- meets, members, overview, charter, facebook -- since the town's markup changes under every page. 8 of 37 boards changed in the 44 days to 28 October 2026. A listing that loses a quarter of its boards is refused. |
| `athletics-schedules` | `fetch_arbiter_schedules.py --refresh` | the holding area; extracted facts only | TJ authorised refetching despite robots.txt; names stripped at fetch, facts only, nothing under sources/. Compared on content. A run with more game pages than its budget exits 2 and resumes the next morning. |
| `open-meeting-law` | `fetch_open_meeting_law.py --refresh` | sources/state-law/ | All 35 documents re-fetched; PDFs compared by bytes, pages by their text. Needs Chrome and Node 22 for the mass.gov pages. |
| `bls-cost-indexes` | `fetch_bls_cost_indexes.py` | sources/federal-bls/ | Monthly CPI series, quarterly wage indexes. Compares the series data, not the bytes: every BLS answer carries its own responseTime. A new value lands a dated version. |
| `dls-cherry-sheet` | `fetch_dls_cherry_sheet.py --recent` | sources/state-dls/ | The current fiscal year and the two before it, by content: the Gateway stamps every zip member with the request time, so bytes never match twice. A final sheet moves only on a correction; a new year arrives after the state budget. |
| `dls-property` | `fetch_dls_property.py` | sources/state-dls/ | Four reports: assessed values, health insurance, self-insured funds, new growth. They fill in through the year as towns certify and file. Compared by content, not bytes. |
| `dls-tax-bills` | `fetch_dls_tax_bills.py` | sources/state-dls/ | A new fiscal year fills in town by town through the autumn and winter, so thirty days, not yearly. Compared by content, not bytes. |
| `dls-tax-rates` | `fetch_dls_tax_rates.py` | sources/state-dls/ | Filled in town by town as each sets its rate, autumn into winter. Compared by content, not bytes. |
| `census-acs` | `fetch_census_acs.py` | sources/state-census/ | One five-year release a year, in December; ninety days catches it by March. Needs the gitignored .census-key. A release the pages are not pinned to is a NOTICE in the run notes. |
| `census-f33` | `fetch_census_f33.py` | sources/state-census/ | Yearly. Lands a new version only when census.gov replaces the file; a newer year’s form is a NOTICE. |
| `dese-enrollment` | `fetch_dese.py` | sources/state-dese/selected-populations-*.html | A new school year once a year, when DESE adds it to its year selector. Years already held are never refetched. |
| `dese-radar` | `fetch_dese_radar.py` | sources/state-dese/radar-district-comparison.xlsx | The workbook changes about yearly and is byte-stable. The profile page is compared on its visible text, since DESE re-releases its site chrome. |
| `dese-sped-expenditure` | `fetch_dese_sped_expenditure.py` | sources/state-dese/radar-sped-direct-expenditure-trends-*.xlsx | Yearly. A new FY08-to-FYnn edition lands under its own name, and the run says the extractor needs repointing. |
| `source-links` | `check_source_links.py --due-days 30 --max 200` | sources/data/link-status.csv | A slice a day, oldest check first. One status request per link, no download. Writes link-status.csv, which the sources page reads. |
| `massgis` | `fetch_massgis_parcels.py` | sources/state-massgis/ | One edition per fiscal year, overwritten in place at the same address, so an edition not taken while it is up is gone. A new edition lands under a dated folder; the pages stay on theirs until moved (a NOTICE). |
| `munis-ledgers` | — | sources/town-ledgers/ | Arrives only when we ask. Each delivery carries a PROVENANCE file. |
| `budget-workbooks` | — | sources/budget-workbooks/ | Arrives only when we ask or somebody sends it. |
| `correspondence` | — | sources/correspondence/ | Arrives only when sent. |

## How it works

- **does: fetches** lands a new copy when the publisher’s changed. **checks** only compares and reports; nothing is downloaded into the archive.
- **when due** means the cadence has elapsed since the last *successful* look. A failed look is recorded as failed and tried again the next morning.
- **a slice a day** spreads a large set across its cycle: each morning checks the documents whose own last check is oldest, a few dozen at most, so no single morning carries the whole set.
- **by hand** rows have a target cadence and no schedule yet. A row stays here until its fetcher has been reviewed for running unattended.
- Every look is a row in `sources/data/source-checks.csv`; per-document results are in `copy-status.csv`, per-dataset results in `socrata-status.csv`.
